part: main loop: Condition and direction, students
question: Does adding a bge-small embedding to word counts lift the engine-readings heads on the full-text view toward the 0.87 presence and 0.76 direction bars?
one_change: add a bge-small embedding to the word counts on the full-text view

baseline.model: T105 heads on the engine's readings, first 1200 words, word counts, presence AUROC

prediction.metric: presence AUROC on held-out engine stories, full-text view, counts plus embedding
prediction.why: T105 gave 0.8556 for word counts alone on this view (runs/pulse/t105/t105_engine_heads.json); a 300-story scratch run of this script, made before this prediction and not scored, showed the embedding neither helps nor hurts at that size; direction accuracy expected 0.72 to 0.77 against 0.740; the bars are 0.87 and 0.76
